description: Dorothy Chen makes a $150 contribution to the Millfield Community Transition Fund — mutual aid pool supporting displaced workers and struggling small businesses during the autonomous vehicle disruption.
motivation: Financially secure retiree with monthly surplus redirecting discretionary funds toward community stabilization. Private act, no recognition sought.

secondary_transaction.description: Visit to Betty's Diner on Auto Row — coffee, meal, generous tip. Economic solidarity with a stressed small business owner Dorothy knows personally.
